glosses: debate, argument (a civil exchange of contradictory points of view)
argument, (verbal) fight, row (a vivid, uncivil exchange of emotional points of view)
conversation, discussion (an exchange of words neither contradictory nor conflictual)

examples.text: Je veux continuer cette discussion demain.
examples.en: I want to continue this discussion tomorrow.

examples.text: Je dois avoir une discussion avec toi.
examples.en: I need to have a talk with you.

examples.text: Nous avons déjà eu cette discussion.
Les deux parties ont des discussions cette semaine.
examples.en: The two sides hold talks this week.
